about: Arturo Corso specializes in criminal defense. He created The Corso Law Center, LLC to ensure that citizens and noncitizens alike had access to courts and fair representation. He understood how difficult it was to start a new life in America, especially for those who did not speak English. He primarily serves people in Georgia but is also licensed in Washington, DC and New York. He specializes in cases with high profile clients and those with potential immigration consequences.

During his career, he has represented a diverse demographic of clients and brought even complex cases to successful completion. If you or a loved one are in trouble, you need Arturo on your side from the beginning. Don't wait to see what happens next. Take control of your case and give yourself the concierge treatment you deserve.
